About SWF Marine

Why We Started
SWF Marine

SWF Marine is SWF Constructions expanding its reach to residential and commercial waterfront owners — it's always easier having a single contact for multiple trades. SWF Marine is the dedicated marine and mechanical arm of SWF Constructions, the Aboriginal-owned Sydney business that's delivered ground-up new home building — including luxury waterfront homes up to $70 million — facilities maintenance and renovations since 1995.

Run out of Taren Point, Sydney — close to the harbour and the Northern Beaches, and covering all Southern Sydney locations — SWF Marine covers everything from a routine service to a full engine room refit, for private boat owners and commercial operators.
